constraints.fixtures: only the fixtures written in the spec and its appendices, created through the UI unless a precondition says otherwise
constraints.codeUnderTest: the integration-branch commit named in the report; the only variable between rounds

sections.title: Journey 1 — Start from a seed template and read it
Journey 2 — Draw a flow: BPMN shapes, multi-branch decision, self-loop, parallel gate
Journey 3 — Step specification, swimlanes that keep their names, saved for good
Journey 4 — Scenarios: shared L2 steps, L3 variants, per-scenario overrides on steps and connectors
Journey 5 — Current state versus Future state, and the link from a Future step to the problem it resolves
Journey 6 — Undo, redo and the structural checks
Journey 7 — Publish with an impact preview, history with source actions, restore
Journey 8 — Download JSON, a one-file HTML viewer and the journey definition; import back
Journey 9 — Templates: save, share rules, use, replace with impact, delete with impact
Journey 10 — Agent draft with the offline test agent
Journey 11 — The studio's definition is configuration (administrator)
Journey 13 — The same capability by API and MCP
